Listening The Great Barrier Reef
Listen to a guide talk to two tourists at the Great Barrier Reef.
Which statements surprise the tourists? Check () the correct answers.
[_] The Great Barrier Reef is made up of many smaller reefs.
[_] You can see the reef from space.
You can see turtles near the reef.

A Wonderful Mountain
Mount Toubkal is the highest mountain in
Morocco. and one of the prettiest. The most
popular time to visit is the summer. Many a
people climb the mountain, and you can hike it
in two days. To mé, the most interesting time
to visit is the winter because you can ski. This
is surprisingto manypeople.
